user_stories.title: Fix health check endpoint integration
acceptance_criteria: Health check routes (/health, /ready, /startup) are added to Cowboy dispatch table in src/app/cre.erl:339
Helm probe paths in values.yaml:206, 215, 224 are updated to use /health, /ready, /startup instead of /status.json
All health endpoints return JSON with 'status' field set to 'healthy', 'unhealthy', or 'starting'
/health returns 200 when BEAM VM is responsive
/ready returns 200 when Mnesia, worker pool, and CRE master are healthy
/startup returns 200 when initialization completes successfully
Existing /status.json endpoint remains functional for status monitoring
All endpoints tested with curl and return valid JSON

Default values are appropriate for production deployments
